name: New York Mysteries: The Undying Collector's Edition
description:
About This Game

A call to the Order brings Laura back into action. This time, Bishop himself joins the investigation.

“New York Mysteries: The Undying” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

New York, 1966. Broadway's spotlights can no longer hide the terror gripping the city. Rumors of mysterious disappearances fill the streets, and the latest abduction is shockingly brazen: performers vanish before hundreds of witnesses who remember nothing.

Drawing on her experience with the supernatural, journalist Laura James takes the case. Its threads reach so deep into the past that even Lucas Bishop, the Order's most senior member, gets involved.

However terrifying the truth, there's no standing still. Search New York for clues and forge a path through the darkness. Stare into it, and your enemy may stare back.

- Immerse yourself in 1960s noir America with an atmospheric soundtrack.

- Hear out the witnesses and decide who to trust—and who to doubt.

- Put your wits to the test with ingenious puzzles.

- Explore every corner of New York and complete collections of unique items.
short_desc: Investigate a case even the police are afraid to touch. “New York Mysteries: The Undying” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.
